Questions

Straight answers

What exactly is free?

The whole server: unlimited users, folders and items, plus every security and governance feature — encryption, security posture, recertification, compliance exports, LDAP/AD, OAuth2 SSO and the API. There is no “enterprise edition” holding features back.

What happens when the extension licence expires?

The extension stops autofilling. Nothing is lost or locked: every credential remains fully accessible through the web interface.

How are extension users counted?

By the number of unique accounts that used the browser extension during the month. Users who only use the web interface are not counted.

Can we move up a pack mid-year?

Yes. What you have already paid is deducted pro-rata from the higher tier.

Why is the extension paid at all?

Maintaining an extension across Chrome, Firefox and Edge is continuous work — three review processes, three sets of breaking changes. Charging for it is what keeps the server free rather than pushing the whole project toward an open-core model where the good features sit behind a licence.

Is there a discount for non-profits or education?

Ask. Get in touch and describe your situation.

Start free. Pay only if the extension earns it.
